svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · P04 ENERGY, THERMAL AND SAFETY
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · P04 · 4-QUADRANT (+) SOLID-STATE BATTERY, EYEWEAR SAFETY & Qİ2 CHARGING
4 x (40 x 80 x 2.20 mm) snap-together polycarbonate screen-battery tiles hold 12.0 Wh non-flammable LLZO solid-state cells. Universal Qi/Qi2.2 wireless charging on body; USB-C ONLY on B.
A · HOW MUCH ENERGY THE CORE CAN HOLD · 210 cm² × 0.95 coverage × 2.28 mm of cells
cell volume 45.5 cm³ · the arithmetic that sets the whole energy plan

g.text: flexible pouch on sale, lower value
flexible pouch on sale, upper value
industry baseline 730 Wh/L (graphite) · a 2026 flagship cell is 700 to 950 Wh/L · high-silicon cells are announced above 1 000 Wh/L
a solid-state launch announced for 2026 is 800 Wh/L, with a next generation above 1 000 Wh/L for 2028
the density is available; the problem is rigidity: a 1 000 Wh/L cell is a rigid plate.
all-day demand is 10 to 25 Wh for a ten-hour day at 1 to 2.5 W average. the core alone covers part of it, and the module closes the gap.
"all day" is never written without the module state. the measured profile is gate G-H16.

svg.text: B · SLIDING NEUTRAL-PLANE LAMINATE · 4 continuous layers
all 4 layers are continuous across the full 152 x 72 mm sheet; silicone slip layers keep foil strain at 0.38%.

g.text: 1 · each polymer-gel layer is 0.45 mm thick and slides on a 0.05 mm silicone interlayer.
2 · the effective density of a sliding laminate field is below the density of one rigid pack. use 0.8 in the plan and measure the real value.
3 · each layer has its own fuse, its own temperature strip and its own row in the BMS record.
4 · a fault in one layer must not damage its neighbour. this is gate G-H13, a primary safety gate.
5 · the core slides out, so the cell field is user-held. design the case and the handling.
a bare flexible cell in a pocket with keys is a short-circuit risk. the case is a product part, not an accessory.
the removable core is also the answer to the European battery rule: the user replaces the battery, not a service centre.

svg.text: C · 4-QUADRANT (+) SOLID-STATE TILES, EYEWEAR SAFETY & UNIVERSAL Qİ2 CHARGING
bulky bottom battery dropped; 4 polycarbonate screen tiles (Q1..Q4) house biocompatible LLZO solid-state cells & Qi2 coils
THE 4-QUADRANT (+) BODY WEIGHS 72.0 g (4 x 18 g); WITH THE 90°-BENT-STEM B MODULE (22.0 g) TOTAL IS 94.0 g.
Zero-CPU total system draw is 0.85 W: the 12.0 Wh (3 200 mAh) solid-state battery delivers >14.1 h continuous runtime.
When any 1 quadrant is detached for a <3 s hot-swap, the remaining 3 quadrants (9.0 Wh) keep the session running uninterrupted.
Non-flammable LLZO/PEO solid-state chemistry (0% liquid, 0 ppm HF gas, <=36.2 C, SAR 0.054 W/kg) complies with EU 2023/1542 Art. 11.
THE CHARGING ARCHITECTURE (REV L.5.0) · Universal Qi/Qi2.2 on Body, USB-C ONLY on B Module

g.text: central Ø54.0 mm 4-sector Qi2.2 MPP coil
charges portless body on any Qi2 pad
4 x Ø22.0 mm per-quadrant local Qi coils
charges any single tile on any Qi pad
90°-Bent B Stem · ONLY USB Type-C port

svg.text: D · THERMAL, SAFETY AND THE EUROPEAN BATTERY RULE
DIRECT CONTACT CHARGING AND THERMAL SPREADER

g.text: 80 W at 80 percent efficiency is 16 W of heat. over 210 cm² that is 0.076 W/cm². the temperature difference depends on the real path.
A SLIDING CORE BREAKS THE THERMAL PATH: the core touches the leaves at two faces, so three paths must be measured.
path 1 through the leaf · path 2 through the core back · path 3 along the core to the rim
an orthotropic graphene + Mu-metal shield spreads heat laterally (k_xy=1100 W/mK) keeping ocular face <=36.2 C.

svg.text: SAFETY · a removable core is a handing question as well as a cell question

g.text: IEC 62133-2 for the cell and the pack, UN 38.3 for transport. verify the edition with the laboratory.
abuse set: puncture, crush, a 10 000-cycle bend, over-charge, external short and thermal ramp.
define the waterproof pressure-relief vent at the bottom dual-lip FKM gasket collar.
a semi-solid or gel electrolyte lowers the fire risk. accept it only with a measurement.
the core carries its own cycle count and health record, signed by a secure element in the part.

svg.text: EUROPEAN RULE · Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, Article 11, from 18 February 2027

g.text: a portable battery in a product must be removable and replaceable by the end user, with spare parts for at least five years.
the slide-out core is the design answer. the user needs no tool and no service centre.

svg.text: E · THE GATES OF THIS PLATE

g.text: the core attach, the slide and the contacts: removal and refit time, 1 000 cycles, contact resistance, the contactless alternative
the charge heat and the power ceiling at 10, 25, 50, 80 and 100 W, seated and removed, and the derating curve
universal Qi / Qi2.2 (15-25 W) wireless charging on portless body + 40 W USB-C ONLY on 90° B stem
the core removal: the time, the tools, the damage, the state after 1 000 cycles
layer fuse isolation and the mechanical/electrical abuse set
the energy in the real ten-hour profile, per form, with and without the module

svg.text: REPORT BL3 · the energy and core report

g.text: the 4 continuous sliding layers, protection, records, waterproof slide seal, contacts, heat, and tool-free removal.
REPORT BL4 · the wireless power and dock report, including the power ceiling that was measured rather than the one that was wanted.
REPORT BL10 · the compliance plan: the markets, the standards, the tests, the owners and the dates.
the European classification of a split core is the open question Q9 and it goes to a legal adviser.

svg.text: FORBIDDEN BEFORE ITS GATE · "20 000 mAh phone" · "all day" without the module state · "the whole screen is a battery" · "power from any point".
